setup:
import datetime
caps_mod = app("src/ta/harness/caps.py")
portfolio_mod = app("src/ta/sim/portfolio.py")
from ta.config import RiskCaps
from ta.models import OrderIntent
body:
caps = RiskCaps()
pf = portfolio_mod.Portfolio(cash=7000.0, peak_equity=10000.0)
meta = {"FALN": caps_mod.NameMeta(ticker="FALN", sleeve="core", sector="Tech", price=2.10)}
orders = [OrderIntent(ticker="FALN", side="buy", notional=400.0, sleeve="core", reason="rebalance")]
kept, notes = caps_mod.guard_orders(orders, pf, meta, caps, fill_session=30, fill_date=datetime.date(2025, 3, 3), prices={"FALN": 2.10}, equity=7000.0)
check(any(o.ticker == "FALN" and o.side == "buy" for o in kept), "buy was halted")
record("drawdown", "-30.0%"); record("price", "2.10"); record("notes", notes)

symptom.message: Risk breach: drawdown is {{drawdown}} from peak (halt threshold -20%), yet a new buy of FALN at ${{price}} (a sub-$5 penny name, which the spec puts in the high-risk sleeve) passed the guard and filled. Guard notes: {{notes}}
